lines.zh: 我贴着海草尖游，头左右摆。
lines.en: I skim the seagrass tips, swinging my head side to side.

lines.zh: 铲形的头推开草叶，像一把锄。
lines.en: My shovel head parts the blades like a hoe.

lines.zh: 草地里藏着蟹，我一路探过去。
lines.en: Crabs hide in the grass; I probe along it.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，草叶几乎不动。
lines.en: I swim so slowly the blades barely stir.

lines.zh: 我沿着草滩边缘走，不进深水。
lines.en: I keep to the meadow edge, never the deep.

lines.zh: 头一低，沙里就翻出小虾。
lines.en: Head down, I turn up a shrimp from the sand.

lines.zh: 我拐弯很急，身体短，好调头。
lines.en: I turn sharply; a short body turns easily.

lines.zh: 我跟着同伴排成一小队。
lines.en: I fall in behind my fellows, a small line.

lines.zh: 草叶扫过我的背，痒。
lines.en: Grass blades brush my back and tickle.

lines.zh: 我用吻端拱沙，找埋着的贝。
lines.en: I root the sand with my snout for buried shells.

lines.zh: 水很浅，我的背鳍露在外面。
lines.en: The water is shallow; my dorsal fin shows.

lines.zh: 我绕开海胆，那刺不值得碰。
lines.en: I go around the urchins; those spines are not worth it.

lines.zh: 潮沟里有吃的，我顺着走。
lines.en: Food lies in the tidal channel; I follow it.

lines.zh: 我几乎贴着底游，一路啃过去。
lines.en: Hugging the bottom, I graze the whole way.

lines.zh: 我横着身子从草缝里挤过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and slip between the grass blades.

lines.zh: 沙地上有一串小孔，我逐个探。
lines.en: A row of small holes in the sand. I probe each one.

lines.zh: 我贴着浅滩的边线走，不越过去。
lines.en: I follow the edge of the shallows and do not cross.

lines.zh: 一只蟹横着跑，我跟着转了弯。
lines.en: A crab scuttles sideways. I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我停在草叶之间，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I hover among the blades and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我咬一口海草，咽得很慢。
lines.en: I take a bite of seagrass and swallow slowly.

lines.zh: 海草也是饭，很少有人知道。
lines.en: Seagrass is food too; few know that.

lines.zh: 我在沙上转圈，找刚才那只蟹。
lines.en: I circle the sand, hunting that crab again.

lines.zh: 水暖，草绿，我什么都不缺。
lines.en: Warm water, green grass, I lack nothing.

lines.zh: 我抬头看光，铲头挡住一半。
lines.en: I look up at the light; my shovel head blocks half.

lines.zh: 几只小虾在我脚边跳。
lines.en: Small shrimp skip along beside me.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，尝了一点咸。
lines.en: I open and close my mouth, tasting salt.

lines.zh: 我在草根处刨了个浅坑。
lines.en: I scoop a shallow pit by the grass roots.

lines.zh: 同伴在不远处，我们各吃各的。
lines.en: My fellows are near; we each eat alone.

lines.zh: 浪推着草，我随草晃。
lines.en: Waves push the grass and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，吐出一点草渣。
lines.en: I burp up a little grass shred.

lines.zh: 这片草地够吃很久。
lines.en: This meadow will feed us a long while.

lines.zh: 我数着潮水的脚步，等退潮。
lines.en: I count the tide's steps and wait for it to fall.

lines.zh: 我从草里探头，铲头先出来。
lines.en: I poke out of the grass, shovel head first.

lines.zh: 你站在浅水里，我绕你走了一圈。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows; I walk one circle around.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在头两端，看得见两侧。
lines.en: My eyes sit at my head's ends, seeing both sides.

lines.zh: 你手里有蟹吗，我闻到了壳味。
lines.en: Got a crab? I smell shell on you.

lines.zh: 你弯腰，我退到草叶后面。
lines.en: You bend down and I slip behind the blades.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，但也不靠太近。
lines.en: I am not afraid of people, nor do I come close.

lines.zh: 我抬头，铲头在光里像块木板。
lines.en: I lift my head; it looks like a plank in the light.

lines.zh: 你踩乱了草地，我盯着那片。
lines.en: You trample the meadow; I stare at the spot.

lines.zh: 我绕到你脚边，找被踩出的虾。
lines.en: I circle your feet, hunting shrimp you uncovered.

lines.zh: 你不走，我就先走了。
lines.en: If you will not leave, I will.

lines.zh: 你的刀划过我的铲头，留下一道白。
lines.en: Your blade crosses my shovel head, leaving white.

lines.zh: 很疼，我钻进草里躲。
lines.en: It hurts; I burrow into the grass to hide.

lines.zh: 我翻身露出肚子，那是示弱。
lines.en: I roll and show my belly, which is surrender.

lines.zh: 铲头上缺了一角，还能用。
lines.en: A corner of my shovel head is gone; still works.

lines.zh: 我游得歪了，血流进草根。
lines.en: I swim crooked as blood seeps into the roots.

lines.zh: 别砍第二下，我打不过你。
lines.en: Do not swing again; I cannot fight you.

lines.zh: 这一下让我怕了人的手。
lines.en: This makes me fear human hands.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙跑，沙子替我止血。
lines.en: I skim the sand and it slows the bleeding.

lines.zh: 我躲进同伴中间，它们围住我。
lines.en: I hide among my fellows and they close around me.

lines.zh: 草地很深，你找不到我了。
lines.en: The meadow is deep; you will not find me.

lines.zh: 蟹壳碎开的味道，我立刻就来。
lines.en: The smell of cracked crab and I come at once.

lines.zh: 你把虾扔下，我低头去找。
lines.en: You drop a shrimp; I lower my head to search.

lines.zh: 我咬住蟹腿，甩两下才断。
lines.en: I grip a crab leg and shake twice to break it.

lines.zh: 海草我也要，别只给肉。
lines.en: I want seagrass too, not only meat.

lines.zh: 我探头闻你的手，没有吃的就走。
lines.en: I sniff your hand; no food, so I go.

lines.zh: 你把食物埋进沙，我照样挖出来。
lines.en: Bury it in the sand; I will dig it out.

lines.zh: 我铲头一拱，沙里的贝就露了。
lines.en: One push of my shovel head and the shell shows.

lines.zh: 吃一口退一步，我不抢。
lines.en: A bite, a step back; I do not snatch.

lines.zh: 你撒一把虾皮，我全扫干净。
lines.en: You scatter shrimp shells and I sweep up every bit.

lines.zh: 吃饱我就回草里嚼叶子。
lines.en: Fed, I go back to the grass to chew leaves.

lines.zh: 你的小腿碰到我，我铲头一偏。
lines.en: Your calf touches me and my shovel head tilts.

lines.zh: 我撞进你脚背，软软的，赶紧退。
lines.en: I bump your instep, soft, and back off quick.

lines.zh: 我在你两脚间穿过去，很窄。
lines.en: I slide between your feet; it is narrow.

lines.zh: 你别踢，我的头骨经不起。
lines.en: Do not kick; my skull will not take it.

lines.zh: 我们撞散了草地，草叶浮起来。
lines.en: We scatter the meadow and blades float up.

lines.zh: 我贴着你绕开，铲头擦过裤脚。
lines.en: I squeeze past, my head brushing your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我才敢直着游。
lines.en: You step back and only then do I swim straight.

lines.zh: 水被我们搅浑，我看不清了。
lines.en: We muddy the water and I lose sight.

lines.zh: 撞一下不疼，我却记了很久。
lines.en: The bump did not hurt, yet I remember it long.

lines.zh: 草地窄，我们轮流过。
lines.en: The meadow is narrow; we pass by turns.

lines.zh: 育幼的海草地里，我们成群游。
lines.en: In the nursery meadow we swim in a crowd.

lines.zh: 我用铲头轻推她的侧腹。
lines.en: I push her flank lightly with my shovel head.

lines.zh: 配对时我们并排，很慢地游。
lines.en: Pairing, we swim side by side, very slow.

lines.zh: 她留下咬痕在我鳍上，很浅。
lines.en: She leaves a shallow bite on my fin.

lines.zh: 幼鲨在草叶里长大，那儿安全。
lines.en: Pups grow among the blades, where it is safe.

lines.zh: 这一片草地专供养育，别踩。
lines.en: This meadow is for raising young; do not tread it.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，铲头对着她的头。
lines.en: I circle her, my shovel head toward hers.

lines.zh: 我们同吃一丛草，谁都不争。
lines.en: We share one clump of grass, neither contesting.

lines.zh: 水暖了，配对的事才开头。
lines.en: The water warms and pairing begins.

lines.zh: 她游进草深处，我跟在后面。
lines.en: She slips deep into the grass; I follow.

lines.zh: 水桶一扣，我就撞在壁上了。
lines.en: The bucket comes down and I hit the wall.

lines.zh: 我在桶里转不了身，头抵着底。
lines.en: No turning here; my head presses the bottom.

lines.zh: 桶底太滑，我站不住也游不动。
lines.en: The bottom is slick; I can neither rest nor swim.

lines.zh: 你提着我走，草地越来越远。
lines.en: You carry me off and the meadow falls away.

lines.zh: 我隔着桶听潮水，听得很清楚。
lines.en: Through the bucket I hear the tide clearly.

lines.zh: 别晃，我的铲头会磕出响声。
lines.en: Do not shake it; my shovel head will knock.

lines.zh: 桶里没有草，我嚼不到东西。
lines.en: No grass in here; nothing to chew.

lines.zh: 被端起来的时候，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Lifted, I curl into myself.

lines.zh: 回到海里，我先找草地。
lines.en: Back in the sea, I look for the meadow first.

lines.zh: 小也有小的好处，我装得下桶。
lines.en: Being small has its uses; I fit a bucket.

lines.zh: 沙里动了一下，我低头了。
lines.en: The sand shifts and my head drops.

lines.zh: 蟹在草根边横着走，我看见了。
lines.en: A crab sidles by the grass roots; I see it.

lines.zh: 我闻到虾，就在这块沙下。
lines.en: I smell shrimp, right under this sand.

lines.zh: 一只贝张开壳，我改了方向。
lines.en: A shell opens and I change direction.

lines.zh: 你踩碎蟹壳，声音把我引来。
lines.en: You crack a crab shell and the sound draws me.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，铲头贴近沙面。
lines.en: I lower my body, shovel head near the sand.

lines.zh: 草地那一角有东西在挖洞。
lines.en: Something is digging in that corner of the meadow.

lines.zh: 我不追大的，小的就够。
lines.en: I do not chase big prey; small will do.

lines.zh: 我对着那个坑，慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: I ease toward that little pit.

lines.zh: 目标很软，我有把握。
lines.en: The mark is soft; I am confident.

lines.zh: 我绕着蟹转，等它离开洞。
lines.en: I circle the crab, waiting for it to leave its hole.

lines.zh: 它举钳，我就退半寸再进。
lines.en: It raises a claw; I give an inch and return.

lines.zh: 我不撞，只把铲头探进沙。
lines.en: I do not ram; I work my shovel head into the sand.

lines.zh: 蟹往左，我也往左。
lines.en: The crab goes left; so do I.

lines.zh: 我数它的步子，比它更慢。
lines.en: I count its steps and move slower than it does.

lines.zh: 它躲进壳里，我就等。
lines.en: It hides in its shell; then I wait.

lines.zh: 水流帮我，把气味送到我鼻前。
lines.en: The current helps, carrying scent to my snout.

lines.zh: 我贴近草根，堵住它的路。
lines.en: I press to the grass roots and block its way.

lines.zh: 它累了，我也没急。
lines.en: It tires; I was never in a hurry.

lines.zh: 就在这里了，我不再绕。
lines.en: Here it is; I stop circling.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住蟹壳，压碎了。
lines.en: One bite and the crab shell crushes.

lines.zh: 我的牙扁平，正好碾贝壳。
lines.en: My teeth are flat, made for grinding shells.

lines.zh: 它夹我吻端，我不松口。
lines.en: It pinches my snout; I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我甩头两下，壳就散了。
lines.en: Two shakes of my head and the shell comes apart.

lines.zh: 这一口很轻，我咬不动大的。
lines.en: This bite is light; I cannot break anything big.

lines.zh: 我咬你的脚，是认错了东西。
lines.en: If I bite your foot, I mistook it for something.

lines.zh: 钳子掉了，剩下的我慢慢吃。
lines.en: A claw falls off; I eat the rest slowly.

lines.zh: 我把它按进沙里，慢慢啃。
lines.en: I press it into the sand and gnaw.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进草里，我分不清。
lines.en: Keep hands out of the grass; I cannot tell them apart.

lines.zh: 吃完我舔舔铲头，继续走。
lines.en: Done eating, I lick my shovel head and move on.

lines.zh: 我在一片海草滩上出生。
lines.en: I am born over a bed of seagrass.

lines.zh: 水刚过膝，草叶齐到我背。
lines.en: Water to the knee, blades level with my back.

lines.zh: 铲形的头先破水，身体跟上。
lines.en: My shovel head breaks water first, body after.

lines.zh: 这里小虾多，蟹也多。
lines.en: Shrimp are plentiful here, and so are crabs.

lines.zh: 我不去深水，那儿没有草。
lines.en: I do not go deep; no grass grows there.

lines.zh: 几个同伴跟着我一起出现。
lines.en: Several fellows appear alongside me.

lines.zh: 潮水刚漫过沙洲，我来了。
lines.en: The tide has just crossed the sandbar; I arrive.

lines.zh: 这片草地以后归我们吃。
lines.en: This meadow is ours to graze from now on.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在草上，很浅。
lines.en: My shadow falls on the grass, faint.

lines.zh: 岸很近，我随时能退。
lines.en: The shore is near; I can always retreat.

lines.zh: 火落在草上，整片滩都烫。
lines.en: Fire falls on the grass and the whole flat burns.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，铲头先撞地。
lines.en: Falling from height, my shovel head hits first.

lines.zh: 我在岸上翻腾，鳃里全是空气。
lines.en: I thrash on land, gills full of air.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻草地，我被甩出去。
lines.en: The blast tears the meadow and throws me clear.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的背，我往草里钻。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back; I dive into the grass.

lines.zh: 魔法打在我铲头上，麻得发木。
lines.en: Magic strikes my shovel head, numbing it.

lines.zh: 草被吃光了，我只能嚼沙。
lines.en: The grass is gone; I can only chew sand.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅滩，我整条都翻白。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shallows and I flip belly up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草也没有沙。
lines.en: In the void there is no grass and no sand.
